settings.title: The cloth
settings.body: At RYVT we choose the cloth before we design to it. Every piece is 8.2 oz cotton, garment-dyed, and washed before it is ever cut.

settings.title: The run
settings.body: Small runs, restocked rather than replaced. When something sells out it comes back, not gets discontinued.

settings.title: The city
settings.body: Cut and finished in Metro Detroit, named for the streets it came from.

settings.heading: Built where we train.
settings.lede: Heavyweight cotton, washed before it is ever cut. Made in small runs in Metro Detroit and named for the streets it came from.
settings.news_body: First look at every drop, an hour before it lists. One email a fortnight, no more.
